name: com.casaprivat/casaprivat
title: CasaPrivat
description: Homes for sale in Spain and France from owners and agencies, plus French price ranges from DVF data.

tools.name: search_homes
tools.description: Search homes for sale in Spain (ES) and France (FR), listed by private owners (no commission) or by estate agencies (fees shown). Returns public listing records incl. the mandatory energy rating.

min_energy_class.description: Only homes with this class or better (A best)

seller_type.description: Only listings by private owners or only by estate agencies (default: both)

include_examples.description: Include fictional EXAMPLE listings (default true in the MVP)

tools.name: get_home
tools.description: Full public record of one published listing by id (e.g. EXAMPLE-ES-1 or ES-XXXXXXXX).

tools.name: get_facets
tools.description: Counts of published listings by country, type and city, price range and valid filter values. No arguments.

tools.name: request_viewing
tools.description: Forwards a question or viewing request from a buyer to the seller of a published home (the owner, or the estate agency for agency listings). It does NOT book a viewing and creates no offer or contract: the seller replies directly to the buyer's email. Requires the buyer's explicit consent to share their name and email with the owner.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or app sending this

buyer_consent.description: true = the buyer agreed that their name, email and message are passed to the seller (owner or agency)

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Read-only tool estimate_price returns, for a French commune and property type, the median price per m² of sales over the last 24 available months as a quartile range with the number of sales (minimum 10) and the date of the data used; source DGFiP DVF, Licence Ouverte 2.0 / Etalab. It is not a valuation. With fewer than 10 sales it returns sufficient=false ('données insuffisantes') and no figures; only aggregates per commune, nothing is stored.

commune.description: Commune name, postcode or INSEE code, e.g. 'Nice', 'Cannes (06)', '06400', '06088'

area.description: Built floor area in m² (surface réelle bâtie, the area DVF uses; optional, without it only €/m² is returned)
